observations: Photo 0 shows a yellow and black petrol generator with 'SUMEC FIRMAN SPG2900' branding on the front panel and top cover.
The front panel includes an engine switch, AC and DC outlets, a circuit protector, and a voltage meter.
Photo 1 shows the front side of the generator, revealing a 5.5 HP engine with 'SFE16' label on the flywheel cover.
Photo 2 shows the rear side with a label containing model details, CE mark, and warnings. The engine cover has 'FIRMAN' embossed on it.
The generator appears to be in used condition with some scuffs and dust, but no visible damage.
The seller claims '2 times used', '100% copper coil', and 'AVR (Automatic Voltage Regulator)' — none of which are visible in the photos.
